overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Top
boxes.derivation: 3/4 plywood lying flat on the frame: 48" across X, 16" up Y, 3/4" thick, its underside at 16 1/2" (the legs' and aprons' tops). Occupies x 0..48, y 0..16, z 16 1/2..17 1/4.

boxes.name: Leg, south-west
boxes.derivation: A 2x4 standing on end, 1" in from the top's west and south edges: its 1 1/2" thickness across X, its 3 1/2" width up Y, 16 1/2" tall (its depth, so its length). Occupies x 1..2 1/2, y 1..4 1/2, z 0..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, south-east
boxes.derivation: Its east face 1" in from the top's east edge, at 48 - 1 = 47", so its west face is at 47 - 1 1/2 = 45 1/2". Occupies x 45 1/2..47, y 1..4 1/2, z 0..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, north-west
boxes.derivation: Its north face 1" in from the top's north edge, at 16 - 1 = 15", so its south face is at 15 - 3 1/2 = 11 1/2". Occupies x 1..2 1/2, y 11 1/2..15, z 0..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, north-east
boxes.derivation: The south-east leg's x with the north-west leg's y. Occupies x 45 1/2..47, y 11 1/2..15, z 0..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Apron, south
boxes.derivation: A 1x4 on edge against the legs' south faces (y = 1): 3/4" thick, so y 1/4..1; from the west legs' west face (x = 1) to the east legs' east face (x = 47), 46" long; 3 1/2" tall (its depth, so its width), its upper edge at the legs' tops, 16 1/2", so z 13..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Apron, north
boxes.derivation: The same against the legs' north faces (y = 15): y 15..15 3/4. Occupies x 1..47, z 13..16 1/2.

boxes.name: End rail, west
boxes.derivation: A 1x4 on edge against the west legs' west faces (x = 1): x 1/4..1; from the south legs' south face (y = 1) to the north legs' north face (y = 15), 14" long up Y; 3 1/2" tall, z 13..16 1/2.

boxes.name: End rail, east
boxes.derivation: The same against the east legs' east faces (x = 47): x 47..47 3/4, y 1..15, z 13..16 1/2.

boxes.name: Stretcher, south
boxes.derivation: A 2x4 lying flat between the south legs' inner faces, x 2 1/2..45 1/2 = 43" long; 3 1/2" up Y matching the legs, y 1..4 1/2; 1 1/2" thick, its underside 4" off the floor, z 4..5 1/2.

boxes.name: Stretcher, north
boxes.derivation: The same between the north legs: x 2 1/2..45 1/2, y 11 1/2..15, z 4..5 1/2.

cutList.label: Top
cutList.derivation: Lies flat: length 48" = 49152, width 16" = 16384, thickness 3/4" = 768 (the 3/4 Performance Category, which is the thickness the stock fixes). Text: 48 = 4 x 12 -> 4'-0"; 16 = 12 + 4 -> 1'-4"; 3/4". Material 3/4 plywood. Longest part, so first.

cutList.label: Apron
cutList.derivation: On edge: length across X 46" = 47104, thickness up Y 3/4" = 768, width its depth 3 1/2" = 3584 — a 1x4's dry size. Text: 46 = 3 x 12 + 10 -> 3'-10". Two boxes, one row of 2; "Apron, south" and "Apron, north" share "Apron, " -> "Apron".

cutList.label: Stretcher
cutList.derivation: Lies flat: length 43" = 44032, width 3 1/2" = 3584, thickness 1 1/2" = 1536 — a 2x4's dry size. Text: 43 = 3 x 12 + 7 -> 3'-7". Two boxes, one row of 2; label "Stretcher".

cutList.label: Leg
cutList.derivation: Stands up: thickness across X 1 1/2" = 1536, width up Y 3 1/2" = 3584, length its depth 16 1/2" = 16896. Text: 16 1/2 = 12 + 4 1/2 -> 1'-4 1/2". Four boxes, one row of 4; label "Leg".

cutList.label: End rail
cutList.derivation: On edge: thickness across X 3/4" = 768, length up Y 14" = 14336, width its depth 3 1/2" = 3584. Text: 14 = 12 + 2 -> 1'-2". Two boxes, one row of 2; "End rail, west" and "End rail, east" share "End rail, " -> "End rail". Shortest, so last.

shoppingList.derivation: Pieces, longest first: 46, 46, 14, 14 (two aprons, two end rails). First-fit decreasing over 6', 8' ... 16': 46 -> no board yet; the shortest stocked length that holds 46" is 6' = 72", 26" left. 46 -> board 1 has 26", too short; a second 6', 26" left. 14 -> board 1 (26") holds it, 12" left. 14 -> board 1 (12") does not, board 2 (26") does, 12" left. So 2 x 6'-0": four pieces out of two boards, and each board carries an apron AND an end rail — the cut list's two rows of 2 are two boards to buy. Board feet, nominal 1" x 4": bought 1 x 4 x (72 + 72) = 576 in³ / 144 = 4.0; used 1 x 4 x (46 + 46 + 14 + 14) = 1 x 4 x 120 = 480 in³ / 144 = 3.333... -> 3.3; waste 576 - 480 = 96 in³ / 144 = 0.666... -> 0.7.

Pieces, longest first: 43, 43, 16 1/2 x 4 (two stretchers, four legs). 43 -> a 6' (72"), 29" left. 43 -> board 1 (29") too short; a second 6', 29" left. 16 1/2 -> board 1, 12 1/2" left. 16 1/2 -> board 1 (12 1/2") no, board 2 (29") yes, 12 1/2" left. 16 1/2 -> neither holds it; a third 6', 55 1/2" left. 16 1/2 -> board 1 no, board 2 no, board 3 yes, 39" left. So 3 x 6'-0" for six pieces. Board feet, nominal 2" x 4": bought 2 x 4 x (3 x 72) = 1728 in³ / 144 = 12.0; used 2 x 4 x (43 + 43 + 4 x 16 1/2) = 2 x 4 x 152 = 1216 in³ / 144 = 8.444... -> 8.4; waste 1728 - 1216 = 512 in³ / 144 = 3.555... -> 3.6. Rounded once each, at the end: the four legs alone would be 2 x 4 x 16 1/2 = 132 in³ = 0.916... each.

shoppingList.derivation: The top, 48" x 16" = 768 in², fits a 48" x 96" sheet (PS 1-19 §5.4) and is its only part: ceil(768 / 4608) = 1 sheet. By area, and so labelled a floor; no board feet for a panel.
